summary: SARFAESI Act enforcement dispute; auction purchaser vs agreement-to-sale holder; DRT voided unauthorized sale agreement; High Court improperly stayed auction post-bid ignoring suppression of material facts; Section 17 alternative remedy available; writ jurisdiction misused for specific performance; no redemption right for sale-agreement holder under TP Act s.91; sale confirmation to auction purchaser upheld.
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; High Court judgment set aside; auction sale to appellant confirmed; respondent no.1's writ petition dismissed.
